brief:
Settlers resumed heavy machinery operations in Salfit on Wednesday, continuing a destructive campaign that has now stretched into its eleventh consecutive day, Shehab Wire reported. The bulldozing effort targeted Palestinian-owned agricultural land across the West Bank governorate, destroying farming terrain in areas where Palestinian communities depend on cultivation for their livelihoods.

The repeated incursions mark an escalation in settlement expansion activities. Authorities have not announced intervention measures to halt the machinery work or protect the affected land plots from further damage during the ongoing operation.
